newsitem.title: THAILAND: China interested in buying 200,000 T Thai rubber.
newsitem.headline: China interested in buying 200,000 T Thai rubber.

text.p: China has expressed interest in buying 200,000 tonnes of rubber from Thailand, a source at the Agriculture Ministry said on Friday.
But details regarding prices, terms of payment and shipment would be further discussed when Deputy Agriculture Minister Krit Kongpetch visits China early next month, the source said.
The trip is to promote Thai natural rubber in China, he said. Thailand exported 339,695 tonnes of rubber to China during January-November of 1996 compared with 150,315 for the whole of 1995.
